title: DocsMap
description: BOM manifest for documentation structure (Tiefenstrukturiertes Dokument / TSD). Adjacency list format — ADR-007.

nodes.description: Flat adjacency list of all BOM nodes. Tree structure is derived via parent_id + order at runtime.

id.description: Stable BOM position code, e.g. 'ARCH-001'. Never a DevSteps work-item ID.

doc_id.description: Optional DOC-NNN work-item that owns this section. Omit for root cluster nodes that span multiple files.

parent_id.description: Parent node ID, or null for root-level nodes.

order.description: Sort order within siblings. Gap numbering (10, 20, 30) is recommended — insert at 15 without renaming.

title.description: Section heading text (mirrors H1–H4 in the TSD file).

description.description: Optional human note for editorial context.

devsteps_items.description: DevSteps work items that produced or govern this node (N:M — one section can relate to multiple items).

tsd_heading_depth_max.description: Maximum heading depth rendered in this subtree (1 = H1 only, 4 = H1–H4). Overrides slider ceiling.

default_depth.description: Default zoom level when VS Code Depth View opens this doc. Presentation hint only.
